items.name: finstack-theme
items.title: Finstack theme
items.description: Shared light and dark tokens, compact and comfortable density, IBM Plex fonts and component styles for every finstack item.
items.docs: Shared light/dark theme. Import styles/finstack/theme.css after Tailwind. Set data-theme and data-density on the app root. Colours, fonts, the type scale and the chart palettes are CSS variables from one token file: rebrand by generating this stylesheet from a brand file with a checkout of the registry (node finstack-quant-ui/scripts/gen-theme.mjs --brand <brand.json> --out <theme.css>) or by redeclaring variables on [data-theme] after it. IBM Plex Sans and Mono are supplied by pinned Fontsource packages under SIL OFL-1.1; no font binaries are copied into registry files.
